title: Anyone experience portal doors between distant locations?
content: In My recurring dreamscape world (bout 20 years I've been having Mallworld dreams) Currently there's three main locations in my very futuristic Dreamworld, one is analogous to Montana in the wilderness, one is Hawaii upcountry jungle and one is.hawaii In the city/coastal area. The city area contains a building that's not only a Mallworld or Arcology or similar, but it's a fucking airship or starship or something, and going through it's various internal compartments you end up walking outside into the other two locations that I've mentioned. It's instant and there's no Jump Airport travel required to move between these three locations.
